# valsoperator_dbsecret (Resource)

Vals Operator DbSecret resource for managing Vault dynamic database credentials

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "valsoperator_dbsecret" "example" {
  name      = "cassandra"
  namespace = "default"

  vault {
    role  = "application_role"
    mount = "database"
  }

  template {
    name  = "CASSANDRA_USERNAME"
    value = "{{ .username }}"
  }

  template {
    name  = "CASSANDRA_PASSWORD"
    value = "{{ .password }}"
  }

  rollout {
    kind = "Deployment"
    name = "my-cass-client"
  }

  renew = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) DbSecret name
- `namespace` (String) DbSecret namespace

### Optional

- `renew` (Boolean) Whether to automatically renew the credentials before they expire
- `rollout` (Block List) List of Deployments or StatefulSets to rollout restart when credentials are renewed (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--rollout))
- `secret_name` (String) Override the Kubernetes secret name (defaults to metadata.name)
- `template` (Block List) Template for the secret data keys (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--template))
- `vault` (Block List) Vault connection configuration (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--vault))
